name: io.github.agentwares/agentguard
description: MCP policy proxy: spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, kill switch, dry-run, audit log.
title: agentguard

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to agentguard.yaml (default ./agentguard.yaml). If unset and that file does not exist, agentguard serves only its own read-only tools: agentguard_get_status, agentguard_get_report, agentguard_verify_audit_log

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_KILL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to halt every tool call (kill switch)
